title: Hearty Crunchy Spanish Tomatoes Gazpacho
description: A refreshing and romantic Spanish dish featuring unwaxed lime and score fat, this gazpacho is perfect for warm weather, made with raw friendly ingredients and bursting with umami flavor.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the diced tomatoes, red onion, cucumber, and red bell pepper.
In a small bowl, whisk together the unwaxed lime juice, score fat, garlic, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the lime juice mixture over the tomato mixture and stir until well combined.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, stir the gazpacho well and adjust the seasoning if needed.
Serve the gazpacho chilled, garnished with a sprinkle of salt and a few slices of cucumber if desired.
